From aa6c6d9ee064aabfede4402fd1283424e649ca19 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Weiming Shi <bestswngs@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 09:53:51 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] bareudp: fix NULL pointer dereference in
 bareudp_fill_metadata_dst()

bareudp_fill_metadata_dst() passes bareudp->sock to
udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup() in the IPv6 path without a NULL check.
The socket is only created in bareudp_open() and NULLed in
bareudp_stop(), so calling this function while the device is down
triggers a NULL dereference via sock->sk.

 BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference, address: 0000000000000018
 RIP: 0010:udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup (net/ipv6/ip6_udp_tunnel.c:160)
 Call Trace:
  <TASK>
  bareudp_fill_metadata_dst (drivers/net/bareudp.c:532)
  do_execute_actions (net/openvswitch/actions.c:901)
  ovs_execute_actions (net/openvswitch/actions.c:1589)
  ovs_packet_cmd_execute (net/openvswitch/datapath.c:700)
  genl_family_rcv_msg_doit (net/netlink/genetlink.c:1114)
  genl_rcv_msg (net/netlink/genetlink.c:1209)
  netlink_rcv_skb (net/netlink/af_netlink.c:2550)
  </TASK>

Add a NULL check returning -ESHUTDOWN, consistent with the xmit paths
in the same driver.

Fixes: 571912c69f0e ("net: UDP tunnel encapsulation module for tunnelling different protocols like MPLS, IP, NSH etc.")
Reported-by: Xiang Mei <xmei5@asu.edu>
Signed-off-by: Weiming Shi <bestswngs@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Kuniyuki Iwashima <kuniyu@google.com>
Reviewed-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260426165350.1663137-2-bestswngs@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/bareudp.c b/drivers/net/bareudp.c
index 0df3208783ad..da5866ba0699 100644
--- a/drivers/net/bareudp.c
+++ b/drivers/net/bareudp.c
@@ -529,6 +529,9 @@ static int bareudp_fill_metadata_dst(struct net_device *dev,
 		struct in6_addr saddr;
 		struct socket *sock = rcu_dereference(bareudp->sock);
 
+		if (!sock)
+			return -ESHUTDOWN;
+
 		dst = udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup(skb, dev, bareudp->net, sock,
 					     0, &saddr, &info->key,
 					     sport, bareudp->port, info->key.tos,
-- 
2.34.1

The patch addresses a NULL pointer dereference bug in `bareudp_fill_metadata_dst()` by adding a NULL check for the socket before use.

**Modifications in `drivers/net/bareudp.c`:**
- Added a guard at line 532 (after obtaining the socket via `rcu_dereference`) that returns `-ESHUTDOWN` immediately if the socket is NULL, preventing the subsequent `udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup()` call from dereferencing a NULL pointer.

**Relationship:**
- The single change in this file directly fixes the crash scenario: when the device is down (socket is NULL), the function now safely exits with an error code instead of proceeding to use a NULL socket pointer, matching the defensive pattern used in other xmit paths of the same driver. No other files are modified.

Root cause:
The function `bareudp_fill_metadata_dst()` in the IPv6 path dereferences `bareudp->sock` (obtained via `rcu_dereference`) without a NULL check. The socket is only created in `bareudp_open()` and set to NULL in `bareudp_stop()`. When the device is down, the socket pointer is NULL, and passing it to `udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup()` leads to a NULL pointer dereference through `sock->sk`.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
struct socket *sock = rcu_dereference(bareudp->sock);
dst = udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup(skb, dev, bareudp->net, sock, ...);

Reason:
When the device is down, `bareudp->sock` is NULL. The `sock` variable is obtained without a NULL check and then passed to `udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup()`, which dereferences `sock->sk`, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
if (!sock)
    return -ESHUTDOWN;

Reason:
A NULL check is added before passing `sock` to `udp_tunnel6_dst_lookup()`. If the socket is NULL (device down), the function returns `-ESHUTDOWN` early, preventing the NULL pointer dereference and making the error handling consistent with similar paths in the driver.
